register.labelZh: EMPTY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: empty out 可以描述餐廳、課室、戲院等地方在人們離開後變得空蕩蕩。；empty out of something 可以描述一群人在活動結束後離開某處。；empty something out 適合用來談論清空袋子、箱子、抽屜、櫃子和口袋。；你可以說 empty a bag out,也可以說 empty the books out of the bag,視乎你想強調容器還是裏面的物品。
register.summaryEn: Empty out can describe restaurants, classrooms, cinemas and other places becoming empty when people leave. Empty out of something can describe a crowd or group leaving a place, especially after an event ends. Empty something out is useful when talking about bags, boxes, drawers, cupboards and pockets. You can empty a bag out or empty the books out of the bag, depending on what you want to focus on.
